title: LaneNetwork
description: Static road/lane graph exported from the Unity scene and loaded by the Python server. Authored once per scene (by a human in the editor or a generator), it is the search space for the planners. Geometry is Unity world space, meters.

scenario.description: Which scenario this network belongs to. Must stay in sync with the 'scenario' enum in state_message.schema.json.

vec3.description: [x, y, z] in Unity world coordinates (meters).

centerline.description: Ordered centerline waypoints, start -> end of lane.

speed_limit.description: Speed limit in m/s (13.9 ~= 50 km/h, 27.8 ~= 100 km/h).

left_lane_id.description: Adjacent lane to the left (same direction), for lane changes.

right_lane_id.description: Adjacent lane to the right (same direction).

next_lane_ids.description: Lane-graph successors reachable by driving forward off the end.
